root_cause: When the drawer dialog is opened via showModal(), no initial focus is set, causing focus to remain on the triggering button or the document body instead of moving inside the dialog.
repair_strategy: Add the autofocus attribute to the close button inside the drawer so that the browser automatically focuses it when the dialog is shown, satisfying the expectation that focus enters the dialog upon opening.

edits.after: <button type="button" class="btn-close" id="filters-close" data-bs-dismiss="drawer" aria-label="Close" autofocus></button>

expected_accessibility_effect: Upon opening the filters drawer, focus will move to the close button, allowing keyboard users to navigate the dialog without a pointer.
functional_risks: If the dialog is opened via a script call that expects focus elsewhere, the autofocus may shift focus unintentionally.
Duplicate autofocus elements could cause focus conflicts, but only one autofocus element exists.
verification_requirements: After activating the Filters button with Enter, the close button (#filters-close) must receive focus.
Pressing Tab from the close button should move focus to the 'In stock' checkbox.
Pressing Escape should close the drawer and return focus to the Filters button.
